summary: In large RTP sessions using RTCP feedback, many receivers sending feedback at once can overload a feedback target. This RFC defines an RTCP extension for third-party loss reports, for cases where feedback should not be forwarded to every receiver.

eli5.summary: In a huge class, if everyone yells that they missed a word, the teacher is swamped. This lets one person report for others.

questions: what is rtcp third-party loss report
how to avoid feedback overload in rtp sessions
